newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian rubber prices down at noon.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian rubber prices down at noon.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted down at noon as the market continued to drift without buying interest, traders said.

At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS1 buyer at 286.50 cents ($1.14) a kg, down one cent from Thursday's close. May SMR20 buyer was also quoted a cent down at 269.50 cents a kg. The market was closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha holiday.
"The market is very dull," said a trader. "There've been no inquiries since opening and there's more room for prices to fall."
A check with trading houses showed SMR 20 being offered at 286 cents a kg, SMR CV at 339, SMR L at 318, SMR 5 at 279, SMR 10 at 269 and drum latex FOB at 230.
Traders said supply of raw materials was improving with sunny weather in recent days and was expected to put further further pressure on prices.
